verdict.rationale: Alma is a tech-enabled immigration law firm with a client portal where users complete questionnaires and submit evidence, so exporting one's data and leaving is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence documents bulk data export, open export formats, or offboarding: the docs cover visa guides, pricing and case workflow, and the probes found only an llms.txt file and no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
